> **Observed:** 2026-09-15T01:05:17Z
> **Do not edit this file. Edit the derived wiki page instead.**

Vik selected exactly two fresh binding tasks after named-anchor host activation. Campaign ordinary-adoption-repair-binding-v2 was frozen and published at375f1c0 before launch; SHA81407b613b9b81852d6e6d6454fb64d7c17355df3f45cd0e00d851a08d75a5dc. Original prompts and638 source files per root were preserved. Terra/high/fork-none first attempts completed in79.151/99.156seconds without nudges or replacements. All46 current and45/28 historical frozen inputs pass. Installed instructions/runtime were snapshotted; caches may be warm and original archive bytes are unavailable.

Both agents found and invoked normal Loci tools. Four retrieves and three reads returned18 relationship records, including repeats. Both received complete positive graph context; one received the specific Options->WorkContextBinding proof through the import/barrel/definition path. All seven responses were fully delivered, including two errors;45 successful source records match fixed bytes. Delivery does not establish internal model reliance.

Median total input479060 is1.921636x original baseline,34.1%above the previous repaired pair and29.4%below the original2.723634x regression. Cached input428544, uncached50516. Visiblebytes128014 (1.041853x) and elapsed89153.5ms (1.211275x) pass the unchanged1.25x ceiling; input fails. Both attempts used11 outer rounds versus baseline median5.5. No graph-only causal, population or billed-dollar conclusion.

Both initial queries were just captureCommandResult. They selected the correct function but omitted its input-options path while delivering an incidental call, caller and return type. The second attempt recovered complete binding proof with a later Options query. Both agents also changed valid, fully delivered source references during transcription: one damaged the content hash and one omitted the repository suffix. Exact reuse succeeded in the same run. This does not prove invalid issuance, broken parsing or clipping; removing manual long-token copying is a robustness proposal.

Both core answers are source-correct and source access passes. Strict original-fact scores are2/3 and1/3: both omit the named Options contract, and the second leaves the public-barrel view re-export unstated. Earlier frozen reviews credited the options clause more generously; they remain unchanged, so individual fact counts are not a calibrated trend. Bare-view and actual-runtime uncertainty remain explicit. The cost failure is independent of fact scoring.

Before launch, separately versioned delivery-v4 passed30 checks and retained collector controls, fixing nested JSON accounting and same-call duplicate-provenance ambiguity without rewriting old observations. The selected campaign is finished with a negative cost verdict. W1.8.4.4 and broader ordinary value acceptance remain open. Recommended next: make function-only lookup deliver the required input-type path, and remove long-reference retyping while preserving repository/hash binding; verify locally before selecting a new bounded frozen comparison. No further product change or provider campaign is selected by this result.

## Current Orientation

The ordinary graph-adoption Objective remains in Implementation. Normal
retrieval runs graph policy deterministically, and the named-anchor/type-proof
repair at `44d1074` passed actual restarted-host acceptance at `b9272f2`.

The newly selected two-task comparison is complete under its separate
pre-outcome freeze at `375f1c0`. Both fresh agents found and invoked Loci, both
received complete positive graph context, and one received the required binding
type proof. This establishes invocation and delivery in these two attempts,
without establishing internal model reliance or dependable full-workload uptake.

Median input was **479,060 tokens, 1.9216 times the original baseline**. It is
34.1% above the previous repaired pair and 29.4% below the original 2.7236-times
regression. Visible bytes and elapsed time pass their unchanged 1.25 limits;
input fails. Both attempts used 11 outer rounds versus a baseline median of 5.5.
Cached input contributes 428,544 of the median total; no billed-dollar or
graph-only causal conclusion follows from these two samples per condition.

Both core contract/view answers are correct and source access passes. Strict
original-fact scores are 2/3 and 1/3: both omit the named options contract, and
one leaves the public-barrel view re-export unstated. Older frozen reviewers
credited the options clause more generously; those records stay unchanged, so
individual fact counts are not a calibrated quality trend. The cost failure is
independent of that judgment, and bare-view/runtime qualifications remain.

**Next: W1.8.4.4 — use the retained failures to improve function-only input-type
selection and remove long source-reference retyping, then verify locally.**
Both first queries named only `captureCommandResult`; both selected the correct
function but omitted its input-options path. A later options query recovered the
complete imported binding proof in one attempt. Both agents also altered a
fully delivered valid source reference. Exact reuse succeeded. The evidence
supports a brittle handoff, not invalid issuance, broken parsing or host clipping.
Eliminating retyping is a proposed robustness change within the desired
deterministic workflow.

Separately versioned delivery-v4 passed 30 checks before the freeze and now
handles complete nested JSON results and same-call duplicate provenance. All 46
current and 45/28 historical frozen inputs, plus both 638-file source snapshots,
pass. Old campaigns and observers are immutable. The selected pair is finished;
no additional product fix or provider campaign is selected by its result.
Any further trial needs a separate selection and pre-outcome freeze, and a
binding-only result cannot close broader ordinary-value acceptance.
